format: Moraff's Revenge Advanced 3.3 dungeon-resource schema v1
method: Static DUNSMALL.EXE control-flow and BLOAD/BSAVE data-flow analysis; no original executable was run.

1.NUM.indexing: BASIC indices 0..2800; payload has 2800 complete words and the low byte of index 2800
1.NUM.dimensions: 70 dungeon levels * 40 monster slots, addressed as 40*level-39 through 40*level
evidence: DUNSMALL:79C3 computes 40*dungeon_level and loops the floor's 40 indices
DUNSMALL:79D4 reads DS:2242[index*2], derives two coordinates, collision-checks DS:4E90, and regenerates the stored value until unoccupied
DUNSMALL:7A6B writes the monster slot index into the 22-wide current-floor occupancy grid
DUNSMALL:A408-A4A6 regenerates and writes both a packed position and its occupancy-grid entry
DUNSMALL:B5FA-B670 BSAVEs the original memory range back to 1.NUM

2.NUM.indexing: BASIC indices 0..2800; payload has 2800 complete words and the low byte of index 2800
evidence: DUNSMALL:6C40 and 6D86 read the absolute value to modify the selected monster graphic/type band
DUNSMALL:8223-8278 loads ABS(table[slot]) into DS:B6E4
DUNSMALL:85AB prints DS:B6E4 directly below the literal ITS HEALTH POINTS:
DUNSMALL:8FA3-8FB2 writes surviving current health back to the same slot
DUNSMALL:A3D1-A404 generates and stores replacement monster health
DUNSMALL:B5FA-B670 BSAVEs the original memory range back to 2.NUM

7.NUM.meaning: sparse special-cell mask layer used by the vertical feature resolver; ordinary walls are generated procedurally and do not come from this file
evidence: DUNSMALL:BA10 loader names 7.NUM and passes explicit address 8366 to BLOAD
DUNSMALL:5275-527B and 54E2-54E8 compute 4*(level*21+row)+8366
DUNSMALL:5449 extracts bit (20-x) from the selected row mask
DUNSMALL:54CB dispatches the vertical-feature resolver only when that bit is set at the player's current cell
DUNSMALL:5793 hashes marked cells as INT(frac(((x+7)^1.3*(y+6)^1.2*(level+search_offset+1)^1.1)/300)*300-3) with MBF single operations
DUNSMALL:552B maps direct hashes 1..9 to negative/up ladders of length 1..3 and searches offsets 1..3 to reconstruct their positive/down endpoints
DUNSMALL:548B computes ordinary movement blocking from floor, direction, coordinates, and a trigonometric runtime call without reading 7.NUM
all 1491 decoded MBF values are nonnegative integer masks no larger than 20 bits
only 10 to 31 cells are set on each level, far too few to encode the maze's wall topology
the final 81 payload bytes are zero in the Advanced 3.3 resource

current_floor_occupancy.meaning: zero for empty or the positive monster slot index occupying that cell

monster_derivation.display_type_adjustment: base types 19 and 20 become 11 and 12 below floor 7; on floor 7 or deeper they become variants 21 and 22 when ABS(persistent_health) > 140
monster_derivation.monster_level: INT(global_index / 40 + 1), plus one for each divisor in 2,4,8,16 that divides global_index exactly
monster_derivation.experience_reward: INT(5 * 1.5^(monster_level^0.96) + 30 * (monster_level - 1)^1.4 + 15); behavior class 2 then multiplies the reward by zero
monster_derivation.replacement_position: x = INT(RND * 18) + 2; y = INT(RND * 17) + 1; packed position = y * 32 + x; x and y reroll together while the current-floor occupancy cell is nonempty, but health is not rerolled
monster_derivation.coin_loot_gate: all even global monster indices guarantee a coin roll; odd indices receive one when INT(RND * 5) <> 1
evidence: DUNSMALL:6BE3-6C0C and 80B0-80DB perform the modulo-20 type expression
DUNSMALL:6C0F-6C5D applies the floor-7 and health-140 type variants
DUNSMALL:80DE-81A3 derives level and tests exact halves, quarters, eighths, and sixteenths
DUNSMALL:839E-84BE computes the experience reward and zeroes it for behavior class 2
DUNSMALL:A3C8-A404 creates replacement health and writes it to 2.NUM's in-memory table
DUNSMALL:A408-A4A6 rerolls replacement coordinates until unoccupied and stores y*32+x in 1.NUM's in-memory table
DUNSMALL:8296-82C7 identifies even global indices; A522-A55E combines that flag with the one-in-five random coin gate

monster_resource_sets.switch_evidence: DUNSMALL:B941-B964 selects set 1 below floor 35 and set 2 otherwise; 4C6B-4CC0 hot-swaps when level-changing across that boundary
